newsitem.title: TURKEY: Missile hits Turk military hostel, little damage.
newsitem.headline: Missile hits Turk military hostel, little damage.

text.p: A missile slammed into a military hostel in the centre of Istanbul on Monday, causing slight damage and smashing windows, Anatolian news agency reported.
It said there were no casualties in the attack at around 8 a.m. (0500 GMT) when a missile hit the 13th floor of the building.
Anatolian said it was not clear who was behind the attack.
Tight security measures were taken around the military complex and one person was detained in connection with the incident, the agency said.
